newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New interim president takes charge of Brazil CVRD.
newsitem.headline: New interim president takes charge of Brazil CVRD.

text.p: The vice-president of recently-privatized Brazilian mining giant CVRD has taken over as acting president until the new owners of the company draw up a new team of executives, a CVRD spokesman said.
Anastacio Ubaldino Fernandes Filho, 49, who has been with the company for 23 years, takes over from Francisco Schettino who left the CVRD presidency Friday, he said.

CVRD's new controling shareholders asked the company's directors to continue in their jobs for six months after privatization to assist them in their analysis of the mining giant, but Schettino asked to be dismissed from his duties earlier than planned.
The international Valepar consortium, led by Brazilian steelmaker CSN bought a controling stake in CVRD May 6 for $3.15 billion.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
